subject: Claimed apps/web/e2e/qbank.spec.ts (lead request): shared quiet()/trackApi from fixtures
body: The lead asked me to fix qbank.spec:443's WebKit flake (a navigation cut off the Builder's /api/cards/stats request; WebKit logs that as a console error, which Playwright reports as pageerror). I'm replacing qbank.spec's local quiet() with the shared quiet() + trackApi() from e2e/fixtures.ts, with trackApi registered before the first navigation. Only the test file changes. I'll release the claim when it's integrated.
